dedupeText: new wave synth pop album aesthetic new wave synth pop 1980s aesthetic motion blur geometric border stylized script central action photo framed by a thick flat colored border diagonal graphic lines intersecting the bottom right corner juxtaposition of rigid geometric display type and loose script warm low key lighting against a cool desaturated background combine a high energy blurred action photo with a thick neutral frame then anchor the composition with a mix of futuristic geometric headers and organic flourishing script that bleeds into geometric accents

recipe.visualDefinition: A dynamic 1980s-inspired composition featuring a central photographic panel framed by a wide neutral border, characterized by high-contrast lighting, motion-blurred figures in expressive poses, and a mix of futuristic geometric and fluid handwritten typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Central action photo framed by a thick, flat-colored border
Diagonal graphic lines intersecting the bottom right corner
Juxtaposition of rigid geometric display type and loose script
Warm, low-key lighting against a cool, desaturated background
coreInvariants: Motion blur on the subjects to imply energy
Three-color graphic icon in the upper right corner
Diagonal parallel lines cutting across the bottom

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three figures positioned mid-ground, slightly off-center to the left, scaled to fill the vertical height of the inner frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure with bright blonde hair acts as the primary focal point due to color contrast.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye enters at the top-right logo, follows the figures' gaze and movement downward to the script in the bottom right, then follows the diagonal lines back across the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Substantial negative space provided by the wide outer border and the dark, textured background within the photo.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks and dark browns (clothing and shadows)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright yellow and orange (typography and graphic elements)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in the environment contrasted with high-saturation, high-value accents in the text and hair.

letterConstructionRules: Display text uses rounded, tubular strokes with open counters
Script text uses a continuous, fluid line with varying pressure
Lower-right script features long, horizontal flourishes that transition into graphic lines
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'n' and 'm' in display text are simplified into arch shapes
The 'S' and 'K' in the script have exaggerated, sweeping ascenders and descenders
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between technological, geometric precision and organic, humanistic handwriting.
graphicDevices: Four parallel diagonal lines in the bottom right corner
Stylized three-head silhouette icon in the top right

preserve: The tubular nature of the top font
The long horizontal tail of the script

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the rounded, simplified forms of the top display text
Approximates the fluid, handwritten feel of the bottom text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A photograph of three people in 80s fashion (dark shirts, high-waisted trousers) in a dimly lit, textured studio with motion blur. Place this inside a wide, flat grey border. Add four thin orange diagonal lines across the bottom right corner.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add geometric rounded display text in the top right with a yellow-orange gradient. Add a large, yellow, hand-drawn script in the bottom right, ensuring the final stroke of the script aligns with the diagonal graphic lines.

verificationChecks: Is the border wide and neutral grey?
Does the script text have a long, flowing horizontal flourish?
Is there a visible motion blur on the subjects?
Are the diagonal lines parallel and consistent in weight?

adjustableVariables: Angle of the diagonal graphic lines
mustRedesign: Exact wording of the title and artist

mustAchieve: Balanced use of negative space in the border
Integration of graphic lines with typography

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not look like a standard system font.
Check that the motion blur feels intentional and energetic.
Verify the color palette remains restricted to the 80s synth-pop theme.
Confirm the diagonal lines intersect the border and the script.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-energy, blurred action photo with a thick neutral frame, then anchor the composition with a mix of futuristic geometric headers and organic, flourishing script that bleeds into geometric accents.
